links.comparator_used: Vendor-pretrained segmentation models used as-is, without institutional training
links.outcome: Auto-segmentation accuracy (average DSC and MSD) against clinically approved contours for head-and-neck, breast and prostate OARs
links.effect: Average DSC vendor-pretrained vs custom-trained: 0.81 vs 0.86 (HN), 0.67 vs 0.80 (breast), 0.87 vs 0.92 (prostate). Average MSD: 0.81 vs 0.76 mm (HN), 4.85 vs 2.42 mm (breast), 2.17 vs 1.21 mm (prostate). Significant improvement for 14 of 24 OARs.
links.tradeoff: Custom training required institutional data: 30-39 training and 5 validation patients per model, with clinically approved contours.
links.quote: Notably, custom-trained models showed significant improvements over vendor-pretrained models for 14 of 24 OARs, reflecting the influence of data/contouring variations in segmentation performance.

design_hint: local custom training of vendor segmentation models on institutional data
